questions.question: What is the default type of a <button> element inside a <form> if no type is specified?
questions.explanation: Inside a form, a button without an explicit type defaults to type="submit" according to the HTML specification.

questions.question: How do you specify default initial text inside a <textarea> element?
options: By placing text between the opening and closing tags: <textarea>Default</textarea>
questions.explanation: <textarea> contains its default text as child text content between <textarea> and </textarea>.

questions.question: Which element groups related <option> elements within a <select> dropdown?
questions.explanation: <optgroup> groups related options under a non-selectable category label.

questions.question: Which element provides a pre-defined list of autocomplete suggestions for an <input> element?
questions.explanation: The <datalist> element contains <option> tags that provide suggested values for an associated <input list="id">.

questions.question: Which button type resets all form controls back to their initial default values?
questions.explanation: <button type="reset"> clears all user modifications and restores original form values.
